Opioid addiction does not have a timeline and does not discriminate. Proud to partner with @RepLarryBucshon, @RepCindyAxne, and @RepChrisPappas to introduce the Timely Treatment for Opioid Use Disorder Act.

https://t.co/N0y4jh4G6H

Skin cancer is, unfortunately, one of the most common cancers with one out of five Americans receiving a skin cancer diagnosis before the age of seventy.

Whenever you are going to be exposed to UV rays make sure you apply sunscreen to minimize your risk of skin cancer! https://t.co/MMrvgvVmsK

On Juneteenth, we celebrate the official end of slavery in the United States. I will continue to strive to make sure that everyone receives equal treatment in the United States. https://t.co/0Mz1hktnTw

Every day our farmers are striving to provide the American people with the necessary nutrition to grow and remain healthy.

https://t.co/YS04Y4wp63

Great to meet with Mike, Sandy, and Sarah for the ALS Association's Hill Day today! I am committed to supporting increased research and treatment for this disease that has taken too many too soon. https://t.co/JDarTZPpUX

I appreciate Randy taking the time to show me Towncrest Wellness Apothecary in Iowa City! They explore various ways to increase accessibility to lifesaving medications for Iowans. https://t.co/ap2mi0gFGw

Honored to kick off “Walk to End Alzheimer’s” ⁦@alzassociation⁩ in Burlington this am. Apparently 1st congressperson to personally appear in almost 2 decades. Committed to cure & treatment for Alzheimer’s & support for those afflicted, their families & caregivers. #endalz https://t.co/M10aiO5EnE
As conditions worsen in Southeast Iowa please exercise caution and continue to tune in to local news and alerts to stay safe.
Please continue to exercise caution when leaving home! @iowadot is working hard to clear the roads, but many are still dangerous.

We welcomed Winston, Best in Show in Purina’s 21st Annual National Dog Show, to our D.C. office! Purina has a factory and other operations in Iowa’s first district and I’m always happy to support our manufacturers, especially when it comes to nutrition for our furry friends. https://t.co/YLrRzSCPwt

NEWS: Miller-Meeks, @RepBradWenstrup , @RepRaulRuizMD, and @RepGwenMoore Introduce Bipartisan, Bicameral Bill to Cover Obesity Treatment in Medicare

In Health Subcommittee of HCVA, we’ve had productive roundtable sessions regarding emerging breakthrough therapies for treatment of PTSD & depression.                 MDMA therapy for PTSD expected to get US approval after latest trial | New Scientist https://t.co/A2kGfbUlxf

Maintaining water quality standards in my district, specifically for communities by the Mississippi River, is crucial. Thank you, Paul Bishop, President & CEO of @GO_WPI, for taking the time to meet with me to discuss critical issues for water and wastewater treatment operators. https://t.co/D1fCVur86j

Incredibly sad to hear of @CongressmanGT's cancer diagnosis. Throughout my time working with Chairman Thompson, I have come to know him as a strong man of faith and a ferocious fighter for Pennsylvanians and the Ag community. I know that you will continue to fight and overcome this disease.

I was proud to vote for the “Whole Milk for Healthy Kids Act” this month!

This legislation will restore the option of whole milk in school nutrition programs. Read more here: https://t.co/LWJ8LhaONK

This Glaucoma Awareness Month let's increase awareness for this debilitating disease, encourage Americans to schedule their regular eye screenings, and commit to advancing more research opportunities that can lead to more treatment options for patients. https://t.co/sKkYfEWEdF

This is a DRILL. Participated in an engaging radiological exercise this morning with Scott County Emergency Management EOC. Having done a few of these exercises both in the military and as a doctor, very proud of their exemplary performance. https://t.co/l2YmLZ80Mm

Winfield Mayor Benford, Angie & JR showed me how the CPF grant we secured for Winfield would upgrade the Wastewater Treatment Facility bringing into EPA compliance. Blowers powered by solar panels make it cost neutral, further reducing operational costs with savings passed on. https://t.co/5pfJkOQFZy

Met with Mediapolis representatives today after I secured $2 million in federal funds for upgrades to the city’s wastewater treatment facility. Exciting things happening in this community! https://t.co/AtOxZ3CWNn
I ask all Americans to pray for the rapid and uneventful recovery of President Biden after his COVID diagnosis.

Enjoyed touring the Hawkins Facility in Camanche, Iowa, where I saw the role they play in local water treatment. Check out this video on how Hawkins is helping to ensure clean water for Iowans! https://t.co/KXS4Sd2fzw
Getting ready for our Tele TownHall with facts on lowering prescription drug costs and reining in PBMs, and of course Diet Coke. https://t.co/5lM9U2JUUB

Visited @uiowa Hospitals and Clinics for two great stops—first, a discussion on the Department of Psychiatry’s research connecting veterans to care through rural clinics and the VA, then a tour of the Hyperbaric Medicine Division focused on wound treatment. https://t.co/rT4hJAD6Gw

The House Doctor’s Caucus has been researching this and this action by DOJ is warranted. The Justice Department is probing billing practices at UnitedHealth Group that triggered extra payments to its Medicare Advantage plans. https://t.co/QCSqB2pm7C

Last week, four U.S. Army soldiers went missing in Lithuania following a training exercise. Today, their bodies were recovered, and the weight of their loss is being felt deeply by Americans everywhere.

As an Army veteran, a mother, and an American, my heart aches for these heroes and their families. They gave everything for our country, and we will never forget their sacrifice.

To their families: you are not alone. These soldiers will be forever honored and remembered. God bless our soldiers and God bless the United States 🇺🇸
